New in this release
• Blur photos and videos until you tap them: for every chat (Settings > Chats) or just one (chat settings > Blur photos and videos). Your own sent media stays clear
• Save received photos and videos to the gallery: for every chat (Settings > Chats) or per chat (chat settings > Save photos and videos to gallery: Default, Always or Never). Never view-once, disappearing or locked-chat media
• Hide contacts: leave someone out of New chat, forwarding and group pickers without blocking them. Long-press them in New chat, or use chat settings > Hide from contacts. Unhide in Settings > Chats > Hidden contacts
• Send silently: long-press Send and pick Send silently. People using Backchannel get no sound or buzz; other Signal apps notify as usual
• Auto reply: an away message for 1:1 chats, at most once every 4 hours per chat, optionally only between set times and until a set date (Settings > Chats > Auto reply)
• Voice message transcripts stay under the message (tap to expand), and Settings > Chats > Transcribe voice messages automatically does incoming ones for you, on the phone only (Android 13 and up)
• Hide group updates from regular members: joined, left and name or photo changes by people who aren't admins disappear from group chats; admins' changes stay (Settings > Chats, or per group in chat settings: Default, Hide or Show)
• Backchannel 2: a second copy of the app, with a 2 on its icon, so you can use a second number on the same phone. It's a separate download from the GitHub releases page, not on Google Play

What Backchannel adds
• Reply privately to a group message
• Reply to one photo of a multi-photo message: open it and tap Reply at the top. Add photos, videos, GIFs (or search for one), files, Immich photos or a sticker, like a normal reply
• Forward to any number of chats, with @mentions
• Send one poll to many chats
• Sticker replies
• Double-tap a message to react
• Starred messages
• Remind me: long-press a message and pick when to be reminded about it
• Note to Self works as a reminder: a new note keeps it unread (on every device) until you open it again
• Keyword alerts: muted chats still notify you when someone uses words you pick (Settings > Notifications)
• Translate a message: long-press it and tap Translate. It uses your phone's offline translator; nothing leaves the phone
• Transcribe voice messages: long-press one and tap Transcribe. It runs entirely on your phone; audio never leaves it (Android 13 and up)
• Markdown: bold, italic, lists, indents, headings, quotes and code blocks (type * item, # Title, > quote or ```), and everyone sees it, Signal users too
• Bold italic and styled copies of text
• Typed :) ;) :( turn into emoji
• One default emoji skin tone (Settings > Chats)
• Immich: attach photos and videos straight from your own Immich server (attach menu > Immich), or use Share > Backchannel from Immich
• Attach photos through Google Photos or another photo app that lets you pick
• Link anyone to a phone contact, even if they hide their number (chat settings > Link to phone contact). It stays linked
• Your own photo for anyone, even people not in your contacts (chat settings > Contact photo)
• Linked phone contacts and your own contact photos show on your linked computers too (Backchannel Web and Signal Desktop)
• Lock any chat behind your fingerprint (chat settings > Lock this chat)
• Optional: accept changed safety numbers without confirming each one (Settings > Privacy, off by default)
